'''CT-642''' was the designation of a [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon-freezing plant]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Accompanied by a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] volunteered to have themselves temporarily frozen to gain access to the [[Gwori system/Legends|Gwori system]] and escape the droid's irradiation gate during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
